features.name: Project Setup & Tooling
features.description: Vite 8 + Bun + TypeScript 7 + React 19. ESLint, oxlint, Prettier, Husky pre-commit hooks, TanStack devtools.

features.name: Routing & Navigation
features.description: File-based TanStack Router with auto-generated route tree. Routes: /notes, /chat, /settings, /profile, /tags, /archived, /login, /register.

features.name: Auth System
features.description: better-auth with email/password login, register, OAuth (GitHub, Google). Zod validation via react-hook-form. Session management.

features.name: Notes CRUD & Editor
features.description: Full note management with Lexical rich text editor, markdown support, auto-save, AI title generation, export to markdown, pin/archive/delete.

features.name: Tags Management
features.description: Tag CRUD with color badges, note counts, filter sidebar integration.

features.name: AI Chat / Copilot
features.description: AI chat with Vercel AI SDK components, model selector, streaming responses, web search toggle, speech input, file attachments, suggestion chips, sources & reasoning display.

features.name: Settings (General, Copilot, Templates)
features.description: Settings with 3 tabs: General (autosave, email digests, copilot alerts), Copilot (name, temperature, avatar, persona, prompt, welcome message), Templates (CRUD custom templates).

features.name: i18n (English & Vietnamese)
features.description: Paraglide JS compiled i18n with EN and VI locales. All user-facing strings via m.*() calls. Cookie-based locale detection.

features.name: Layout: Sidebars & Header
features.description: Left collapsible sidebar (logo, NavMain Platform, NavCompanion, NavSecondary, user dropdown). Right sidebar with direct ChatBot. Top header with sidebar trigger, search bar (opens command palette), theme toggle, right sidebar toggle.
features.evidence: src/layouts/app-left-sidebar.tsx, src/layouts/app-right-sidebar.tsx, src/layouts/app-top-header.tsx, src/layouts/nav/nav-main.tsx, src/layouts/nav/nav-companion.tsx, src/layouts/nav-secondary.tsx, src/routes/_app.tsx

features.name: Pomodoro Timer (Focus)
features.description: Pomodoro timer with work/short break/long break cycles, SVG ring indicator, session counter.

features.name: Draft Editor (Scratchpad)
features.description: Quick scratchpad with auto-save, copy to clipboard, export to note.

features.name: Command Palette
features.description: Keyboard-activated command palette (Ctrl+K / Cmd+K or click search bar) with 5 slash commands (/help, /theme, /stats, /notes, /create), output panels, note search, theme toggle, logout.

features.name: Profile Page
features.description: User profile display with avatar, name, email, join date, note count stats.

features.name: Notes Version History
features.description: View and restore previous note versions from localStorage history.

features.name: Theme System
features.description: Light/dark/system theme with View Transition API circle animation, persisted preference.

features.name: Note Templates
features.description: 6 predefined templates (Meeting, Journal, Project, RFC, Sprint Retro, Study) + custom templates with markdown content, title patterns.

features.name: Archived Notes View
features.description: Separate route and view for archived notes with unarchive action.

features.name: Filter Sidebar for Notes
features.description: Collapsible filter sidebar with tag filtering, category folders, recent notes list.

features.name: Paginated Notes List
features.description: Client-side pagination with page size selector (10/20/50/100), first/prev/next/last navigation.

features.name: Note Templates Settings Tab
features.description: Full CRUD for custom note templates within settings page, with inline dialog editor.

features.name: Copilot Config Persistence
features.description: Persistent copilot configuration (name, temperature, avatar, persona, custom instructions, prompt, welcome message) via localStorage.

features.name: Keyboard Shortcut Guard
features.description: Editor guard on sidebar global keydown to prevent Ctrl+B conflict with Lexical bold. Also adds open-command-palette event for search bar click trigger.
